authorisation: D75 (2026-10-27) under the Product Owner's mission 'Finish OneGate installer closure by resolving the remaining stale-CSR enrollment defect (F1)'. It authorises the correction, its validation on the isolated test pair and the protected merge. It does NOT authorise any PRE-LIVE or production change or Go-Live.
context: The fresh-VM installer (PR #256) was merged as 5b4c5c67 on 2026-10-27 without a transition of its own; its validation is recorded in the installation manual Appendix 3, where it found F1. This receipt records the correction of F1.
root_cause: replaceWaitingIdentity adopted a reinstalled waiting appliance's new identity but left the previous installation's CSR pending; Central kept answering 'pending', so the new installation never filed its own CSR, and Activate signed the old one: a certificate for a key nobody holds.
validation_environment: Isolated test pair, never connected to PRE-LIVE 172.21.60.25 or the production Central 172.21.96.196: lab Central central.onegate.getsemantics.com (release onegate-central-d799ff5fc737 via central-deploy.sh, migrations 56/0/0, smoke 9/9) and test appliance 172.21.96.97 (onegate-appliance-d799ff5fc737 via appliance-install.sh --upgrade, units PASS, five service binaries embedding d799ff5f).
verification: Six new regression tests fail on the previous code and pass now (Central integration against a migrated database: reinstall before activation; a request older than the identity against FetchCertificate, Activate, Reissue and the appliance's own CSR. Appliance: foreign certificate refused and replaced, no request flooding, reconcile, store writes nothing for a foreign key). Full suites pass: control-plane internal/api and internal/pki; data-plane internal/appliancecert and cmd/scd. Live on the test pair: installation A filed CSR A; the reinstall (installation B) voided it (csr_voided, voided_certificate_requests 1), Central answered none and B filed its own; Activate signed B's request; the certificate's public key equals the appliance's mtls-client.key; mTLS verified, assignment applied, licence Active, Central connected, zero Reissue certificate actions; a new Client 12/12 after a reboot.
lab_security: The pre-deploy age-encrypted Central dump was decrypted on the workstation (the holder key never on Central) and restored into a disposable database; it matched the live database exactly. The plaintext first-install dump on the lab Central was then shredded, and the local decrypted copies and the scratch database removed. The lab Root CA key remains in pki-offline (0600), untouched.
follow_up: Deploying this correction to the PRE-LIVE appliance and the production Central is a separate decision. Observed only because the reinstall was simulated at the identity level on a running VM (not a product path): acctd and netd keep the appliance id they started with, and netd's activation journal and the site database's appliance mirror name the previous id.
